_comment: Synthetic lab data for the fictional operator Contoso Telecom. Category IDs must match triage_desk/models.py.

categories.name: Network & Connectivity
categories.description: Loss or degradation of mobile data, voice calls, SMS, home internet, or coverage in an area.

categories.name: Device, SIM & Services
categories.description: Handsets, SIM and eSIM activation, voicemail and call-feature configuration, device warranty.

categories.name: Billing & Payments
categories.description: Charges, refunds, recharges, invoices, payments and payment-related suspensions.

categories.name: Roaming
categories.description: Service problems or questions while the customer is outside the home network country.

categories.name: Account & Plan Changes
categories.description: Plan upgrades and downgrades, bundle changes, ownership transfer and account details.

categories.name: Service Complaint
categories.description: Complaints about staff conduct, store or support experience, or repeated unresolved issues.

categories.name: Unclassified / Needs Information
categories.description: The message is too vague to categorise, or it is outside the scope of telecom support.

priorities.name: Critical
priorities.definition: Complete loss of service for a business customer or for multiple lines, or impact on emergency calling.

priorities.name: High
priorities.definition: Complete loss of a key service for a single consumer, service suspended, or a third repeat complaint.

priorities.name: Medium
priorities.definition: Partial degradation, billing disputes, device faults, or an issue with a known workaround.

priorities.name: Low
priorities.definition: Information requests, plan changes, feedback, or out-of-scope messages.
